bio: The interior design of this restaurant is sleek and modern, in keeping with the futuristic look of the hotel that houses it on its first floor. Diners sit in an airy, high-ceilinged room lit by chic designer pendant lamps – large floor-to-ceiling windows afford magnificent views of the surrounding countryside. Choose from an appealing selection of regional and international classics, or opt for the tasting menu. Full of flavour and depth, the dishes are testament to the skill of the kitchen team....
